reasons: Cited Section 22 satisfies every material term of the preferred position: once per twelve months (22.1), thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2).
Walk-away triggers are absent — audits are notified and capped, and direct access to Customer systems/unrelated Customer Data/privileged material is expressly prohibited.
Compliant classification correctly carries no redline and no comment; rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs, and the deterministic frequency check passes.
Rationale accurately notes customer-favourable extras in 22.3 without overstating; nothing suggests another unconstrained audit/inspection right binding Customer.
